title.narrative: National appeal 'Help slachtoffers aardbeving' (support victims earthquake Türkiye and Syria)

description.narrative: On Monday, February 6, a terrible disaster completely changed the lives of millions of people in Türkiye and Syria. Multiple powerful earthquakes and aftershocks caused massive damage. More than 50,000 people died and many others were injured. At least 2.7 million people were left homeless. In exceptional disasters, 11 Dutch collaborating aid organizations join forces under Giro555. Doctors of the World takes part in the emergency aid provision for Türkiye and Syria. The funding is used to provide medical care and psychosocial support to the affected people.

recipient-country.narrative: Earthquake-affected communities in Hatay in Türkiye, have improved physical health and are supported psychosocially in their journey of recovery
The health of earthquake-affected communities in Western Aleppo and Idlib is enhanced with the provision of medication as part of inclusive and comprehensive primary health care services.

sector.narrative: Doctors of the World provides Emergency Healthcare: PHC, MHPSS, SRHR, (S)GBV/ Protection- services to the earthquake affected population in Turkiye and Syria. To IDP's, refugees and Turkish population
